title: [BUG] AAPS 3.3.3.0-dev-d; Repeated "RUNNING MODE UPDATED" entries & additional sync problems
body: I'm experiencing an issue with the AndroidAPS app where the "RUNNING MODE UPDATED" entry is being logged multiple times per second, as shown in the screenshots below. This behavior started without any manual interaction. Problem Description: Hundreds of identical log entries "RUNNING MODE UPDATED" with the same timestamp are recorded in the User Inputs section. See attached screenshots for reference (log spam between 04:13 and 04:16 on 05.12.25). Additional context: This issue seems related to syncing problems, which have already been reported in a previous issue #4385 . The current issue might be part of the same root cause or regression.
